name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 and delivered 5 leads at $43.90 each across 11,850 impressions.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads on $153.40 spend, with a $30.68 cost per lead and a 1.4% click rate across 8,800 impressions and 120 clicks.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 and drew 30 clicks from 3,050 impressions (1.0% click rate) but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead.
November 2026 is 28 days from closing; Meta spend so far this month is $487.00.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads, mature): 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, 8 lost after conversion. No leads were closed as not qualified and none were closed before applying.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads, mature): 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, 9 lost after conversion — the strongest hire count of the mature cohorts.
The 2026-10-26 cohort (12 leads) is too young to judge: 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, none hired yet, 1 lost after conversion — movement is still in progress.
